caption: The drawing shows a single rooster depicted in profile, facing to the right. The rooster is dark gray in color and displays detailed textures and patterns on its feathers. Its body, wings, and tail feature layered, curving lines to represent feather structure. The tail is fanned out in an arc and composed of long, separated feathers each marked with fine lines. The rooster's head has a comb and wattle, with a small, rounded eye and a pointed beak. Both legs are visible; one leg is raised while the other supports its body and extends downwards, with clearly drawn claws. The background of the drawing is a light, off-white or beige color with no additional objects or elements present. The composition centers the rooster with ample blank space surrounding it, and there is a faint artist’s signature in the lower left corner.
title: Weather Vane - Cock
